content: I've been translating some of the examples from *Software Design by Example* into Gleam and Lean. My focus is Lean as a functional programming language, rather than the theorem proving aspects. For the next few examples, I need a basic HTTP client library and an equally bare-bones HTTP server library. I'd be grateful for pointers to modules I should try out. Thanks in advance - Greg
Is that ready? I saw the pull request merged but nothing in the release notes
Sorry, I meant is the server ready?
I haven't done any more work on this, but I'd be happy to review and merge pull requests from people who know more about the topic than I do. (I'm still just learning Lean.)

Http Client is on the build: lean4#13902
And server is available here : https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/tree/master/src/Std/Http
@Greg Wilson nice to see you here, and even nicer to see you have this in mind, I love your book(s)!

Thanks @Julian Berman - still not sure how far I'm going to take this, but it's been fun learning a little Lean. I'd be interested to hear how you're using it and what for - I'm gvwilson@third-bit.com if you have time to chat.
